{{Top|leg}}
'''Command bunker 1''' was a heavily fortified defense bunker that the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] used during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to hold back the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] assault on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] while the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] could evacuate. The bunker had [[Power droid/Legends|ammo]] and [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]] inside it to assist in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|battle]]. During the battle, the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], with the assistance of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], captured the bunker.

==Behind the scenes==
Although Command Bunker 1 remains similar in both ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]'' and ''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Renegade Squadron]]'', the area around it was very different. In ''Battlefront II'', there was a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] behind the bunker, but in ''Renegade Squadron'', the hangar was replaced by [[Command bunker 2|Command Bunker 2]]. Also, there was a great chasm to the right of the bunker that disappeared in ''Renegade Squadron''.
